verdict.rationale: Name.com documents an availability-check endpoint that checks up to 50 names at once and returns pricing, and its site offers bulk domain search. That covers the core availability-lookup part of the story. Nothing in the pack shows alternate-TLD suggestions or any policy against front-running searched names. The community complaints concern pages inserted under owned domains, not search squatting, so they are off-topic. Missing for 10: evidence of instant or real-time lookup speed, alternate TLD suggestions, a no-front-running commitment for searched names, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, domain search is fast and honest — instant availability, alternate TLD suggestions, and no lookup-then-squat games on names I searched

citations.quote: Checks whether up to 50 domain names are purchasable and returns **discovery** pricing for each result.
Explore more ways to secure the perfect domain... browsing expiring domains, premium names, and bulk search options.
